client.conversationSync.inDownloads: Added to Downloads. You can pause or resume at any time. Conversations will be imported automatically when the download finishes.
client.conversationSync.moveHint: After syncing, conversations move to Codex GUI and are removed from the source folder. Related conversations are included. Finish related tasks first.
client.conversationSync.copyHint: Conversations are copied to Codex GUI. The originals stay in the remote folder. Related conversations are included. Finish related tasks first.

client.conversationSync.changed: Conversation content has changed. Cancel and select the conversations again before syncing.
